q: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल की किस परत में लगभग सभी मौसमी घटनाएँ (बादल, वर्षा, चक्रवात) घटित होती हैं और ऊँचाई के साथ तापमान घटता है?
e: The Troposphere (क्षोभमंडल, average height ~18 km at equator and ~8 km at poles) contains ~75% of atmospheric mass and all weather events; temperature drops at the Normal Lapse Rate of 6.5°C per 1,000 m. Exam Boosters: (1) Stratosphere hosts the Ozone layer and is ideal for jet aircraft; (2) Mesosphere is the coldest layer where meteors burn up; (3) Ionosphere (within Thermosphere) reflects radio waves.
qe: Which layer of the Earth's atmosphere contains almost all weather phenomena (clouds, rainfall, cyclones) and experiences a decrease in temperature with altitude?

q: पृथ्वी की भूपर्पटी (Crust) को मैंटल (Mantle) से अलग करने वाली भूकंपीय असंबद्धता (discontinuity) क्या कहलाती है?
e: The Mohorovičić (Moho) Discontinuity separates the Crust and Mantle (मोहो असंबद्धता भूपर्पटी और मैंटल को अलग करती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Conrad — Upper & Lower Crust; (2) Repetti — Upper & Lower Mantle; (3) Gutenberg — Mantle & Outer Core; (4) Lehmann — Outer & Inner Core.
qe: The seismic discontinuity separating the Earth's Crust from the Mantle is known as the:

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा उच्च ताप और दाब के कारण चूना पत्थर (Limestone) से निर्मित कायांतरित (रूपांतरित) शैल का उदाहरण है?
e: Limestone (sedimentary) metamorphoses into Marble (संगमरमर). Exam Boosters: (1) Shale → Slate; (2) Sandstone → Quartzite; (3) Granite → Gneiss; (4) Coal → Graphite / Diamond.
qe: Which of the following is an example of a Metamorphic rock formed from Limestone under intense heat and pressure?

q: भूकंप की तीव्रता (क्षति के प्रभाव) को मापने के लिए किस पैमाने का उपयोग किया जाता है, जो परिमाण मापने वाले रिक्टर पैमाने से भिन्न है?
e: The Modified Mercalli Scale (I to XII) measures earthquake intensity/damage, whereas the Richter Scale / Moment Magnitude Scale measures energy released (भूकंप की तीव्रता मरकेली पैमाने से और परिमाण रिक्टर पैमाने से मापा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Beaufort Scale measures wind force; (2) Fujita Scale measures tornado intensity; (3) P-waves (primary) travel through solids, liquids, and gases; S-waves travel ONLY through solids.
qe: Which instrument is used to measure the intensity (damage effects) of an earthquake, as distinct from the Richter scale which measures magnitude?

q: 'वृहत् ज्वार-भाटा' (Spring Tides) की घटना तब होती है जब सूर्य, पृथ्वी और चंद्रमा एक सीधी रेखा (युति-वियुति) में होते हैं:
o: First and Third Quarter Moon only
e: Spring tides occur twice a month on Full Moon (पूर्णिमा) and New Moon (अमावस्या) when solar and lunar gravitational pulls reinforce each other. Exam Boosters: (1) Neap Tides (लघु ज्वार) occur at First and Third Quarter when Sun and Moon are at 90° (quadrature); (2) Bay of Fundy (Canada) experiences the world's highest tidal range (~15–16 m).
qe: The phenomenon of 'Spring Tides' (highest high tides and lowest low tides) occurs when the Sun, Earth, and Moon are aligned in a straight line (Syzygy) during:
oe: First and Third Quarter Moon only

q: कौन-सी ठंडी महासागरीय जलधारा दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट के साथ उत्तर की ओर बहती है और अति-शुष्क अटाकामा मरुस्थल का निर्माण करती है?
e: The cold Humboldt (Peru) Current flows northward along Chile and Peru, suppressing coastal rainfall and forming the Atacama Desert (हम्बोल्ट/पेरू ठंडी जलधारा). Exam Boosters: (1) Benguela Current (cold) creates the Namib/Kalahari deserts (SW Africa); (2) Canary Current (cold) flanks the Sahara (NW Africa); (3) Gulf Stream and Kuroshio are warm ocean currents; (4) Warm + cold current mixing zones (e.g., Gulf Stream + Labrador at Grand Banks) are the richest fishing grounds.
qe: Which cold ocean current flows northward along the western coast of South America, creating the hyper-arid Atacama Desert?

q: स्टैलेक्टाइट, स्टैलेग्माइट, घोल रंध्र (डोलाइन) और युवाला किस भू-आकृतिक कारक द्वारा निर्मित विशिष्ट स्थलाकृतियाँ हैं?
e: Karst topography forms in limestone/dolomite regions through chemical dissolution by underground water (भूमिगत जल द्वारा निर्मित कार्स्ट स्थलाकृति). Exam Boosters: (1) Glacial landforms: Cirque, Arete, Horn, U-shaped valley, Moraines, Drumlins; (2) Wind landforms: Mushroom rock (Gara), Yardang, Barkhan dunes, Loess; (3) River landforms: V-shaped valley, Meanders, Ox-bow lake, Natural levees, Delta.
qe: Stalactites, stalagmites, sinkholes (dolines), and uvalas are characteristic landforms produced by which geomorphic agent?

q:
निम्नलिखित स्थानीय पवनों को उनके प्रवाहित होने वाले क्षेत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. चिनूक — (a) आल्प्स (यूरोप)
2. फॉन — (b) रॉकी पर्वत (उत्तरी अमेरिका)
3. सिरॉको — (c) सहारा से भूमध्य सागर
4. हरमट्टन — (d) पश्चिमी अफ्रीका ('डॉक्टर पवन')
e: Chinook ('Snow-eater') — Rockies; Foehn — Alps; Sirocco (warm dusty wind causing 'blood rain' in Italy) — Sahara/Mediterranean; Harmattan ('Doctor Wind' giving relief from humid heat) — West Africa. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following Local Winds with the regions where they blow:
1. Chinook — (a) Alps (Europe)
2. Foehn — (b) Rocky Mountains (North America)
3. Sirocco — (c) Sahara to Mediterranean
4. Harmattan — (d) West Africa ('Doctor Wind')

q: अल्फ्रेड वेगनर के महाद्वीपीय विस्थापन सिद्धांत (1912) के अनुसार, पुराजीवी महाकल्प के अंत में विद्यमान एकल महामहाद्वीप को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Wegener named the supercontinent 'Pangaea' (पैंजिया) and the surrounding mega-ocean 'Panthalassa' (पैंथालासा). Pangaea later split into northern Laurasia (Angaraland) and southern Gondwanaland separated by the Tethys Sea. Exam Boosters: (1) Plate Tectonics Theory (1960s — Harry Hess, Tuzo Wilson, Morgan, McKenzie) explained the mechanism via mantle convection currents and seafloor spreading.
qe: According to Alfred Wegener's Continental Drift Theory (1912), the single supercontinent that existed during the late Paleozoic era was called:

q: कोपेन के जलवायु वर्गीकरण में अक्षर कोड 'Cs' किस विशिष्ट जलवायु प्रकार को दर्शाता है जिसकी विशेषता शुष्क ग्रीष्मकाल और आर्द्र शीतकाल है?
e: In Köppen's scheme, 'C' = Warm temperate (mesothermal) and 's' = dry summer → 'Cs' is Mediterranean Climate (भूमध्यसागरीय जलवायु, 30°–45° western margins, famous for citrus fruits and wine). Exam Boosters: (1) Af = Tropical Rainforest; Aw = Tropical Savanna; BWh = Hot Desert; ET = Tundra; (2) Mediterranean climate receives winter rain from shifting Westerlies.
qe: In Köppen's Climate Classification, the letter code 'Cs' represents which distinct climatic type characterized by dry summers and wet winters?

q:
कोरिओलिस बल के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह उत्तरी गोलार्ध में प्रवाहित वायु को दाईं ओर तथा दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में बाईं ओर विक्षेपित करता है (फेरेल का नियम)।
कथन II: कोरिओलिस बल भूमध्य रेखा पर अधिकतम और ध्रुवों पर शून्य होता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is INCORRECT because Coriolis Force is proportional to sin(latitude): it is ZERO at the Equator (0°) and MAXIMUM at the Poles (90°) (इसी कारण भूमध्य रेखा पर उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात नहीं बनते).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Coriolis Force:
Statement I: It deflects moving air to the right in the Northern Hemisphere and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere (Ferrel's Law).
Statement II: The Coriolis Force is maximum at the Equator and zero at the Poles.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: निम्नलिखित में से किस जल निकाय में औसत लवणता सर्वाधिक है?
e: Lake Van (Turkey) has a salinity of ~330‰ (parts per thousand), higher than the Dead Sea (~238‰) and Great Salt Lake (~220‰) (तुर्की की वॉन झील की लवणता ~330‰ सर्वाधिक है). Exam Boosters: (1) Average salinity of world oceans is ~35‰; (2) Highest salinity among seas/oceans occurs in the subtropical high-pressure belts (20°–30° N/S) where evaporation exceeds precipitation; (3) Isohalines are lines joining places of equal salinity.
qe: Which of the following water bodies has the highest average salinity among open/enclosed saline bodies listed?

q: विलियम मॉरिस डेविस के 'अपरदन चक्र' (सामान्य अपरदन चक्र) में अंतिम लगभग समतल अपरदित सतह, जिस पर बिखरी हुई अवशिष्ट पहाड़ियाँ होती हैं, क्या कहलाती है?
e: Davis (1899) described the three stages (Youth, Maturity, Old Age) culminating in a 'Peneplain' (समप्राय मैदान) with resistant residual hills called 'Monadnocks' (मोनाडनॉक). Exam Boosters: (1) L. C. King proposed 'Pediplain' with 'Inselbergs' (arid/savanna cycle); (2) Walther Penck proposed 'Endrumpf' and emphasized slope replacement rather than slope decline.
qe: In William Morris Davis's 'Geographical Cycle of Erosion' (Normal Cycle), the final almost flat erosional surface dotted with isolated residual hills is termed:

q: यदि ग्रीनविच (0° देशांतर) पर दोपहर के 12:00 बजे हैं, तो 82°30' पूर्वी देशांतर पर स्थित स्थान का स्थानीय सौर समय क्या होगा?
e: Earth rotates 15° per hour (1° = 4 minutes). For 82.5° E: 82.5 × 4 = 330 minutes = 5 hours 30 minutes AHEAD of GMT (since East) → 12:00 Noon + 5:30 = 5:30 PM (भारत का मानक समय IST = GMT + 5:30).
qe: If it is 12:00 Noon at Greenwich (0° longitude), what will be the local solar time at a place located at 82°30' E longitude?

q: पर्यावरणीय निश्चयवाद और संभववाद के बीच मध्यमार्ग के रूप में 'नव-निश्चयवाद' (रुको और जाओ निश्चयवाद) की अवधारणा किसने प्रतिपादित की?
e: Australian geographer Griffith Taylor introduced 'Neo-Determinism' (Stop-and-Go Determinism), comparing nature to a traffic controller who sets pace/limits without dictating direction (ग्रिफिथ टेलर ने नव-निश्चयवाद दिया). Exam Boosters: (1) Friedrich Ratzel ('Anthropogeographie') and Ellen Semple championed Environmental Determinism; (2) Vidal de la Blache and Lucien Febvre championed Possibilism (संभववाद).
qe: Who propounded the concept of 'Neo-Determinism' (also known as 'Stop-and-Go Determinism') as a middle path between Environmental Determinism and Possibilism?

q:
विश्व की निम्नलिखित जनजातियों को उनके पारंपरिक निवास क्षेत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. पिग्मी — (a) कालाहारी मरुस्थल
2. बुशमैन (सैन) — (b) कांगो बेसिन
3. मसाई — (c) पूर्वी अफ्रीकी सवाना (केन्या/तंजानिया)
4. एस्किमो (इन्यूट) — (d) आर्कटिक टुंड्रा
e: Pygmy — Congo Basin; Bushman — Kalahari Desert; Masai (pastoralists living in Kraals) — East Africa; Eskimo (living in Igloos, using Kayaks/Sledges) — Arctic Tundra. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following indigenous tribes of the world with their traditional habitats:
1. Pygmy — (a) Kalahari Desert
2. Bushman (San) — (b) Congo Basin
3. Masai — (c) East African Savanna (Kenya/Tanzania)
4. Eskimo (Inuit) — (d) Arctic Tundra

q: जनांकिकीय संक्रमण मॉडल (DTM) के किस चरण में मृत्यु दर तेजी से गिरती है जबकि जन्म दर उच्च बनी रहती है, जिससे 'जनसंख्या विस्फोट' होता है?
e: In Stage II (Early Expanding), improved sanitation, medicine, and food supply sharply cut death rates while birth rates stay high, creating rapid natural population growth (द्वितीय चरण में जनसंख्या विस्फोट होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Demographic Transition Theory was formulated by W. S. Thompson (1929) and Frank Notestein (1945); (2) Malthus's Population Theory (1798) stated population grows geometrically while food supply grows arithmetically.
qe: In the Demographic Transition Model (DTM), which stage is characterized by a rapidly falling death rate while the birth rate remains high, causing a 'Population Explosion'?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, जनसंख्या की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे बड़ा अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) समूह कौन-सा है?
e: As per Census 2011, Bhil (~1.70 crore, mainly in MP, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Maharashtra) is India's largest Scheduled Tribe, followed by Gond (~1.32 crore) and Santhal (जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार भील भारत की सबसे बड़ी जनजाति है). Exam Boosters: (1) Tharu is the largest tribe in Uttar Pradesh (Tarai belt); (2) Toda tribe inhabits the Nilgiri Hills (Tamil Nadu); (3) Jarawa, Onge, and Sentinelese inhabit Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
qe: Which Indian tribal group is the largest Scheduled Tribe (ST) in India by population according to Census 2011?

q: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में बोस्टन से वाशिंगटन डी.सी. तक फैले सतत नगरीकृत गलियारे का वर्णन करने के लिए 1957 में 'मेगालोपोलिस' (Megalopolis) शब्द किसने गढ़ा था?
e: French geographer Jean Gottmann popularized 'Megalopolis' (1957) for the BosWash urban corridor (जीन गॉटमैन ने मेगालोपोलिस शब्द दिया). Exam Boosters: (1) Patrick Geddes coined 'Conurbation' (1915); (2) Walter Christaller formulated Central Place Theory (1933) using hexagonal market areas (k=3, k=4, k=7); (3) Ernest Burgess gave the Concentric Zone Model of urban structure (1925).
qe: Who coined the term 'Megalopolis' (meaning 'Great City') in 1957 to describe the continuous urbanized corridor stretching from Boston to Washington D.C. in the USA?

q: नदियों, नहरों, तटीय सड़कों या रेल लाइनों के किनारे स्वाभाविक रूप से कौन-सा ग्रामीण बस्ती प्रतिरूप (settlement pattern) विकसित होता है?
e: Linear (रेखीय) settlement patterns develop along transport arteries, river levees, or narrow valleys. Exam Boosters: (1) Circular patterns develop around ponds, lakes, or oases; (2) Star-like / Radial patterns develop at road junctions where several routes converge.
qe: Which rural settlement pattern develops naturally along rivers, canals, coastal roads, or railway lines?

q: एवरेट ली के 'प्रवास सिद्धांत' (1966) के अनुसार, प्रवास के निर्णय चार कारक समूहों द्वारा नियंत्रित होते हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ली के चार कारकों में शामिल नहीं है?
o: Fixed gravitational attraction proportional only to coastal length
Factors associated with the area of destination (Pull factors)
Factors associated with the area of origin (Push factors)
e: Everett Lee's 4 factor groups are: Origin factors, Destination factors, Intervening obstacles, and Personal factors (एवरेट ली के चार कारक: उद्गम, गंतव्य, मध्यवर्ती बाधाएँ और व्यक्तिगत कारक). Exam Boosters: (1) E. G. Ravenstein formulated the earliest 'Laws of Migration' (1885) noting most migrants travel short distances in steps.
qe: According to Everett Lee's 'Theory of Migration' (1966), migration decisions are governed by four sets of factors. Which of the following is NOT one of Lee's four factor groups?
oe: Fixed gravitational attraction proportional only to coastal length
Factors associated with the area of destination (Pull factors)
Factors associated with the area of origin (Push factors)

q: मानव प्रजातियों के उद्भव के ग्रिफिथ टेलर के 'प्रवास कटिबंध सिद्धांत' (Zones and Strata Theory) में किस मानव प्रजाति को सबसे बाहरी परिधीय क्षेत्र (मध्य एशिया से सबसे पहले प्रवासित) में रखा गया है?
e: Taylor's Migration Zone Theory posits Central Asia as the cradle of human evolution; the earliest/oldest race (Negrito) was pushed to the farthest peripheries, while the youngest (Alpine/Mongoloid) remained near the core (सबसे बाहरी क्षेत्र में नीग्रिटो प्रजाति).
qe: In Griffith Taylor's 'Migration Zone Theory' (Zones and Strata Theory) of human racial evolution, which human race is placed in the outermost peripheral zones (oldest/earliest to migrate from Central Asia)?

q:
स्थानांतरित कृषि (कर्तन एवं दहन कृषि) के निम्नलिखित क्षेत्रीय नामों को उनके देशों/क्षेत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. मिल्पा — (a) ब्राज़ील
2. रोका — (b) मेक्सिको एवं मध्य अमेरिका
3. लदांग — (c) इंडोनेशिया एवं मलेशिया
4. झूम — (d) उत्तर-पूर्व भारत
e: Milpa — Mexico/Central America; Roca — Brazil; Ladang — Indonesia/Malaysia; Jhum — North-East India. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d. Exam Boosters: (1) Podu (Andhra/Odisha), Bewar/Dahiya (MP), Kumari (Western Ghats), Chena (Sri Lanka), Ray (Vietnam), Tamrai (Thailand).
qe:
Match the following regional names of Shifting Cultivation (Slash-and-Burn agriculture) with their countries/regions:
1. Milpa — (a) Brazil
2. Roca — (b) Mexico & Central America
3. Ladang — (c) Indonesia & Malaysia
4. Jhum — (d) North-East India

q: जर्मनी का 'रूर क्षेत्र' (Ruhr Region), जिसे यूरोप का औद्योगिक हृदय स्थल कहा जाता है, ऐतिहासिक रूप से किसके समृद्ध भंडार के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: The Ruhr Valley in Germany is renowned for high-grade Bituminous Coal and iron-steel manufacturing (रूर क्षेत्र बिटुमिनस कोयले के लिए प्रसिद्ध है). Exam Boosters: (1) Chota Nagpur Plateau (Damodar Valley) is called the 'Ruhr of India'; (2) Donbas (Ukraine) and Appalachian (USA) are other major bituminous coal basins.
qe: The 'Ruhr Region' of Germany, often called the industrial heartland of Europe, is historically famous for its rich deposits of:

q: स्वेज नहर (1869 में खोली गई) किन दो प्रमुख जल निकायों को जोड़ती है?
e: The Suez Canal (Egypt, ~193 km, sea-level lock-free canal) connects the Mediterranean Sea (Port Said) and the Red Sea (Port Suez), shortening the Europe–India sea route by ~7,000 km (स्वेज नहर भूमध्य सागर व लाल सागर को जोड़ती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Panama Canal (opened 1914, lock-system) connects Atlantic and Pacific Oceans; (2) Kiel Canal connects North Sea and Baltic Sea.
qe: Which two major water bodies are connected by the Suez Canal (opened in 1869)?

q: जोहान हेनरिक वॉन थ्यूनेन के 'कृषि अवस्थिति सिद्धांत' (1826) में केंद्रीय बाजार नगर के ठीक चारों ओर सबसे भीतरी संकेंद्रित वलय (क्षेत्र 1) में कौन-सी कृषि गतिविधि होती है?
e: Because milk, vegetables, and fruits are highly perishable and costly to transport, Market Gardening and Dairying occupy Zone 1 closest to the city (क्षेत्र 1: दुग्ध उत्पादन व शाक-सब्जी). Exam Boosters: (1) Von Thünen's 6 rings: (1) Market gardening/dairying, (2) Forestry/firewood, (3) Intensive crop farming, (4) Crop-pasture/field grass, (5) Three-field system, (6) Extensive livestock ranching.
qe: In Johann Heinrich von Thünen's 'Agricultural Location Theory' (1826), which agricultural activity occupies the innermost concentric ring (Zone 1) immediately surrounding the central market city?

q: अल्फ्रेड वेबर के 'औद्योगिक अवस्थिति सिद्धांत' (1909) में, यदि कोई उद्योग भार-ह्रास (weight-losing) कच्चे माल का उपयोग करता है (पदार्थ सूचकांक > 1, जैसे लौह-इस्पात या चीनी), तो न्यूनतम लागत वाली आदर्श अवस्थिति कहाँ होगी?
o: Midpoint between raw material and port
Near the source of raw materials
e: When Material Index (MI = Weight of localized raw materials / Weight of finished product) > 1, locating near the raw material source minimizes transport costs (भार-ह्रास उद्योग कच्चे माल के स्रोत के निकट लगाए जाते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Weber used 'Isodapanes' (lines of equal total transport cost) and 'Isotims' (lines of equal transport cost for a single input); (2) Footloose industries (MI ≈ 1, e.g., electronics, cotton textiles) can locate flexibly.
qe: In Alfred Weber's 'Theory of Industrial Location' (1909), if a manufacturing industry uses 'weight-losing' (gross) raw materials (Material Index > 1, e.g., iron-steel or sugar), where is the optimal least-cost factory location?
oe: Midpoint between raw material and port
Near the source of raw materials

q: विश्व की सबसे लंबी रेल लाइन (~9,289 किमी) कौन-सी है जो यूरोपीय रूस में मॉस्को को प्रशांत तट पर स्थित व्लादिवोस्तोक से जोड़ती है?
e: The Trans-Siberian Railway (~9,289 km) runs across Russia from Moscow to Vladivostok (ट्रांस-साइबेरियन रेलवे विश्व की सबसे लंबी रेल लाइन है). Exam Boosters: (1) Canadian Pacific Railway connects Montreal/Halifax to Vancouver; (2) Trans-Australian Railway connects Sydney to Perth.
qe: Which is the longest railway line in the world (~9,289 km), connecting Moscow in European Russia to Vladivostok on the Pacific coast?

q: विश्व-प्रसिद्ध 'फजेंडा' (विशाल कहवा बागान) और 'विश्व का कहवा पत्तन' (सैंटोस) किस देश में स्थित हैं?
e: Brazil is the world's largest coffee producer; its large coffee estates are called 'Fazendas' (grown on fertile 'Terra Roxa' soil) and exported via Santos port (ब्राज़ील में कहवा बागानों को फजेंडा कहा जाता है).
qe: The world-famous 'Fazendas' (large coffee plantations) and the 'Coffee Port of the World' (Santos) are located in which country?

q: विश्व के निम्नलिखित शीतोष्ण घास के मैदानों (प्रमुख वाणिज्यिक गेहूँ उत्पादक क्षेत्र) में से कौन-सा अपने क्षेत्र से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: 'Downs' are temperate grasslands of AUSTRALIA, whereas the temperate grasslands of South Africa are called 'Veld' (डाउंस ऑस्ट्रेलिया में हैं; दक्षिण अफ्रीका में वेल्ड घास के मैदान हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Canterbury Plains — New Zealand; (2) Pustaz — Hungary; (3) Tropical grasslands: Savanna (Africa), Llanos (Venezuela), Campos (Brazil).
qe: Which of the following Temperate Grasslands of the world (major commercial wheat-growing 'Breadbaskets') is NOT correctly matched with its region?

q: कौन-सा देश विश्व में बॉक्साइट (एल्यूमीनियम अयस्क) का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है और प्रसिद्ध पिलबरा लौह अयस्क क्षेत्र का घर भी है?
e: Australia leads global Bauxite production (Weipa, Gove mines) and Iron Ore exports (Pilbara region, Western Australia) (ऑस्ट्रेलिया बॉक्साइट व लौह अयस्क का प्रमुख उत्पादक है). Exam Boosters: (1) Kalgoorlie and Coolgardie in Australia are famous gold mines; (2) Mesabi Range (Lake Superior, USA) and Carajás (Brazil) are world-famous iron ore regions.
qe: Which country is the world's largest producer of Bauxite (aluminium ore) and also home to the famous Pilbara Iron Ore region?

q:
न्यूफाउंडलैंड तट (उत्तर-पूर्व उत्तरी अमेरिका) के पास स्थित 'ग्रैंड बैंक्स' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह गर्म गल्फ स्ट्रीम और ठंडी लैब्राडोर जलधारा के मिलन के कारण विश्व के सबसे समृद्ध मत्स्य क्षेत्रों में से एक है।
कथन II: उथला महाद्वीपीय मग्नतट और पोषक तत्वों का ऊपर आना प्रचुर प्लवक (प्लैंक्टन) वृद्धि को बढ़ावा देता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. The mixing of warm Gulf Stream and cold Labrador Current over the shallow Grand Banks creates dense fog and ideal conditions for plankton and cod fisheries (दोनों कथन सही हैं).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Grand Banks' off the coast of Newfoundland (North-East North America):
Statement I: It is one of the world's richest marine fishing grounds due to the convergence of the warm Gulf Stream and the cold Labrador Current.
Statement II: The shallow continental shelf and nutrient upwelling promote abundant plankton growth.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के मिर्जापुर/प्रयागराज के निकट से गुजरने वाली किस देशांतर रेखा को भारत की मानक याम्योत्तर (IST) के रूप में अपनाया गया है?
e: 82°30' E longitude is India's Standard Meridian (IST = GMT + 5 hrs 30 min), passing through 5 states: UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh (82°30' पूर्वी देशांतर भारत की मानक याम्योत्तर है).
qe: Which longitudinal meridian (82°30' E) is adopted as the Standard Meridian of India (IST), passing near Mirzapur/Prayagraj in Uttar Pradesh?

q: बंगाल की खाड़ी में कौन-सा चैनल अंडमान द्वीप समूह को निकोबार द्वीप समूह से अलग करता है?
e: The Ten Degree Channel (10° N latitude) separates Little Andaman from Car Nicobar (दस डिग्री चैनल अंडमान और निकोबार को अलग करता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Eight Degree Channel separates Minicoy from Maldives; (2) Nine Degree Channel separates Minicoy from Lakshadweep; (3) Duncan Passage separates South Andaman and Little Andaman; (4) Barren Island (Andaman) is India's only active volcano.
qe: Which channel separates the Andaman group of islands from the Nicobar group of islands in the Bay of Bengal?

q: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा नदी डेल्टा — सुंदरबन डेल्टा (जो सुंदरी मैंग्रोव वृक्षों और रॉयल बंगाल टाइगर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है) — किन दो नदियों द्वारा निर्मित है?
e: The Ganga–Brahmaputra (Padma–Meghna) Delta is the world's largest delta (गंगा और ब्रह्मपुत्र नदियों द्वारा सुंदरबन डेल्टा निर्मित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Majuli (Assam, on Brahmaputra) is the world's largest river island; (2) Brahmaputra is called Tsangpo in Tibet, Dihang in Arunachal, and Jamuna in Bangladesh.
qe: The world's largest riverine delta — the Sundarbans Delta, famous for Sundari mangrove trees and Royal Bengal Tigers — is formed by which two rivers?

q: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा लौह एवं इस्पात संयंत्र द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान पश्चिमी जर्मनी के तकनीकी सहयोग से स्थापित किया गया था?
e: Rourkela Steel Plant (Odisha) was set up with West German collaboration (राउरकेला इस्पात संयंत्र पश्चिमी जर्मनी के सहयोग से स्थापित हुआ). Exam Boosters: (1) Bhilai (Chhattisgarh) — USSR (2nd Plan); (2) Durgapur (West Bengal) — UK (2nd Plan); (3) Bokaro (Jharkhand) — USSR (3rd Plan); (4) TISCO (Jamshedpur, 1907) was India's first major integrated private steel plant.
qe: Which of the following Iron and Steel plants in India was established during the Second Five-Year Plan with technical collaboration from West Germany?

q: सतलुज नदी और काली नदी के बीच स्थित हिमालय का प्रादेशिक विभाजन (मुख्यतः उत्तराखंड) क्या कहलाता है?
e: Sir Sidney Burrard's river-based division of the Himalayas: Indus–Sutlej = Punjab/Kashmir Himalaya; Sutlej–Kali = Kumaon Himalaya; Kali–Teesta = Nepal Himalaya; Teesta–Dihang = Assam Himalaya (सतलुज से काली के बीच कुमाऊँ हिमालय है).
qe: Which Himalayan regional division lies between the Sutlej River and the Kali River (primarily covering Uttarakhand)?

q: भारत में 'लैटेराइट मृदा' — जो काजू, चाय, कहवा और ईंट निर्माण के लिए उपयुक्त है — मुख्य रूप से किन परिस्थितियों में बनती है?
o: High temperature and heavy seasonal rainfall causing intense leaching
Volcanic lava cooling in semi-arid plateaus
e: Laterite soil forms in high-temperature, heavy-rainfall areas (Western Ghats, Meghalaya, Odisha hills) via intense 'leaching' (निक्षालन) that washes away silica and lime, leaving behind iron and aluminium oxides.
qe: 'Laterite Soil' (लैटेराइट मृदा) in India — well-suited for cashew nuts, tea, coffee, and brick-making — is formed primarily under conditions of:
oe: High temperature and heavy seasonal rainfall causing intense leaching
Volcanic lava cooling in semi-arid plateaus

q:
भारत की निम्नलिखित बहुउद्देशीय नदी घाटी परियोजनाओं को उनकी संबंधित नदियों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. हीराकुंड बाँध — (a) सतलुज
2. भाखड़ा नांगल बाँध — (b) महानदी
3. नागार्जुन सागर बाँध — (c) कृष्णा
4. टिहरी बाँध — (d) भागीरथी
e: Hirakud (Odisha, longest earthen dam) — Mahanadi; Bhakra Nangal (HP/Punjab) — Sutlej; Nagarjuna Sagar (Telangana/AP) — Krishna; Tehri (Uttarakhand, highest dam in India at 260.5 m) — Bhagirathi. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following Multipurpose River Valley Projects of India with their respective rivers:
1. Hirakud Dam — (a) Sutlej
2. Bhakra Nangal Dam — (b) Mahanadi
3. Nagarjuna Sagar Dam — (c) Krishna
4. Tehri Dam — (d) Bhagirathi

q: कौन-सा भारतीय राज्य तांबा अयस्क (खेतड़ी खदानें) और जस्ता-सीसा (जावर खदानें) दोनों का प्रमुख उत्पादक है?
e: Rajasthan hosts Khetri (Jhunjhunu) for Copper and Zawar/Rampura Agucha for Lead-Zinc (राजस्थान खेतड़ी तांबा व जावर जस्ता-सीसा के लिए प्रसिद्ध है). Exam Boosters: (1) Malanjkhand (MP) is India's largest open-cast copper mine; (2) Kolar & Hutti (Karnataka) — Gold; (3) Panna (MP) — Diamonds; (4) Jaduguda (Jharkhand) — Uranium.
qe: Which Indian state is the leading producer of both Copper ore (Khetri mines) and Zinc-Lead (Zawar mines)?

q: भारत के पश्चिमी तट पर कच्छ की खाड़ी (गुजरात) में स्थित एकमात्र प्रमुख ज्वारीय बंदरगाह कौन-सा है, जिसका नाम बदलकर दीनदयाल पोर्ट रखा गया है?
e: Kandla Port (Deendayal Port, Gujarat) is a major tidal port developed after Partition to compensate for the loss of Karachi Port (कांडला / दीनदयाल बंदरगाह गुजरात में स्थित ज्वारीय बंदरगाह है). Exam Boosters: (1) Visakhapatnam (AP) is India's deepest land-locked natural harbour; (2) Kolkata/Haldia is India's major riverine port (on Hooghly); (3) JNPT (Nhava Sheva, Mumbai) is India's largest container port.
qe: Which of the following is the ONLY major tidal port on India's western coast, located in the Gulf of Kutch (Gujarat) and renamed Deendayal Port?

q:
भारतीय मानसून के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: हिमालय के उत्तर में उपोष्णकटिबंधीय पश्चिमी जेट स्ट्रीम के खिसकने और प्रायद्वीपीय भारत पर उष्णकटिबंधीय पूर्वी जेट स्ट्रीम के उभरने से दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून का प्रस्फोट होता है।
कथन II: सकारात्मक हिंद महासागर द्विध्रुव (Positive IOD) सामान्यतः भारत में मानसून वर्षा को कम करता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is INCORRECT because a POSITIVE Indian Ocean Dipole (warmer western Indian Ocean near Africa than eastern Indian Ocean near Indonesia) ENHANCES monsoon rainfall over India (even offsetting El Niño) (सकारात्मक IOD भारतीय मानसून को मजबूत करता है).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indian Monsoon:
Statement I: The withdrawal of the Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream north of the Himalayas and the emergence of the Tropical Easterly Jet Stream over Peninsular India trigger the burst of the South-West Monsoon.
Statement II: Positive Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) generally suppresses monsoon rainfall over India.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: भारत के निम्नलिखित राष्ट्रीय जलमार्गों (NW) में से कौन-सा अपने नदी/जलमार्ग खंड से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: NW-3 — Kollam to Kottapuram (West Coast Canal, Kerala)
e: NW-4 connects Kakinada to Puducherry along the GODAVARI–KRISHNA river-canal system (Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu), NOT Narmada–Tapi (NW-4 गोदावरी-कृष्णा प्रणाली पर है, नर्मदा-तापी पर नहीं). Exam Boosters: (1) NW-1 (1,620 km) is India's longest operational National Waterway.
qe: Which of the following National Waterways (NW) of India is NOT correctly matched with its river/waterway stretch?
oe: NW-3 — Kollam to Kottapuram (West Coast Canal, Kerala)

q: 'करेवा' — सरोवरीय हिमनद-मृत्तिका निक्षेप जो जाफरान (कश्मीरी केसर) की खेती के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं — किस क्षेत्र में पाए जाते हैं?
o: Kashmir Valley (between Pir Panjal and Great Himalayas)
e: Karewas are thick unconsolidated lacustrine deposits in the Kashmir Valley (Jhelum basin), world-famous for GI-tagged Kashmir Saffron, almonds, and walnuts (करेवा कश्मीर घाटी में पाए जाते हैं).
qe: 'Karewas' — lacustrine (lake-bed) glacial-clay deposits famous for the cultivation of Zafran (Kashmir Saffron) — are found in which region?
oe: Kashmir Valley (between Pir Panjal and Great Himalayas)

q: भारत में 'स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज' (Golden Quadrilateral) राजमार्ग नेटवर्क के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: Its North-South and East-West Corridors intersect at Nagpur.
Its total length is approximately 5,846 km.
It is managed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
It connects Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
e: The North-South Corridor (Srinagar to Kanyakumari) and East-West Corridor (Silchar to Porbandar) intersect at JHANSI (Uttar Pradesh), NOT Nagpur (उत्तर-दक्षिण और पूर्व-पश्चिम गलियारे झाँसी में मिलते हैं, नागपुर में नहीं).
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the 'Golden Quadrilateral' highway network in India is NOT correct?
oe: Its North-South and East-West Corridors intersect at Nagpur.
Its total length is approximately 5,846 km.
It is managed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
It connects Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.

q: किसने राजनीति विज्ञान की प्रसिद्ध परिभाषा दी कि "राजनीति विज्ञान का प्रारंभ और अंत राज्य के साथ होता है"?
e: J. W. Garner gave the classic state-centric definition: "Political Science begins and ends with the State" (गार्नर के अनुसार राजनीति विज्ञान का आरंभ व अंत राज्य से होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) David Easton defined politics as "the authoritative allocation of values for a society"; (2) Harold Lasswell defined politics as "Who gets what, when, how"; (3) Paul Janet said Political Science treats the foundations of the State and principles of government.
qe: Who famously defined Political Science as "Political Science begins and ends with the State"?

q: आधुनिक राजनीति विज्ञान के अनुसार राज्य के चार आवश्यक तत्व कौन-से हैं?
e: The 4 essential elements of a State are Population (जनसंख्या), Definite Territory (निश्चित भू-भाग), Government (सरकार), and Sovereignty (संप्रभुता). Exam Boosters: (1) Sovereignty is the 'soul of the State' that distinguishes the State from all other associations; (2) Before 1947, India had population, territory, and government, but was not a sovereign State.
qe: According to modern Political Science, which are the four essential elements of a State?

q: आधुनिक राजनीति वैज्ञानिकों द्वारा राज्य की उत्पत्ति के किस सिद्धांत को सर्वाधिक वैज्ञानिक और ऐतिहासिक रूप से सटीक माना जाता है?
e: The Historical/Evolutionary Theory holds that the State is neither a handiwork of God nor the result of brute force or a single contract, but a gradual historical growth shaped by kinship, religion, force, property, and political consciousness (ऐतिहासिक/विकासवादी सिद्धांत सर्वाधिक मान्य है). Exam Boosters: (1) Sir Henry Maine advocated the Patriarchal Theory; (2) Edward Jenks and McLennan advocated the Matriarchal Theory; (3) King James I of England ('The True Law of Free Monarchies') championed Divine Right of Kings.
qe: Which theory of the origin of the State is regarded by modern political scientists as the most scientific and historically accurate?

q: 'द मॉडर्न स्टेट' (1926) पुस्तक किसने लिखी और कहा कि "रक्त-संबंध समाज का निर्माण करता है और समाज अंततः राज्य को जन्म देता है"?
e: R. M. MacIver ('The Modern State', 1926) emphasized the sociological evolution of the State from family and kinship groups (मैकआइवर का प्रसिद्ध कथन). Exam Boosters: (1) MacIver also called the State a "service corporation" and a key proponent of Pluralism.
qe: Who wrote 'The Modern State' (1926) and argued that "Kinship creates society and society at length creates the State"?

q: किस राजनीतिक सिद्धांतकार ने राजनीति विज्ञान में 'व्यवहारवादी क्रांति' को व्यवस्थित रूप दिया और इसके आठ बौद्धिक आधारस्तंभ (नियमन, सत्यापन, तकनीक, परिमाणीकरण आदि) प्रस्तुत किए?
e: David Easton systematically codified Behaviouralism's 8 tenets and later initiated 'Post-Behaviouralism' (1969) with the twin slogans 'Relevance' and 'Action' (डेविड ईस्टन ने व्यवहारवाद व उत्तर-व्यवहारवाद को सूत्रबद्ध किया). Exam Boosters: (1) Charles Merriam is regarded as the 'Intellectual Godfather of Behaviouralism' (Chicago School).
qe: Which political theorist introduced the 'Behavioural Revolution' in Political Science and outlined its eight intellectual foundation stones ('Regularities, Verification, Techniques, Quantification, Values, Systematization, Pure Science, Integration')?

q: 'लेक्चर्स ऑन ज्यूरिसप्रूडेंस' (1832) में संप्रभुता के एकलवादी (कानूनी) सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन किसने किया और कानून को "संप्रभु का आदेश" कहा?
e: John Austin defined Sovereignty as a determinate human superior receiving habitual obedience from the bulk of society and rendering habitual obedience to no one, making law "the command of the sovereign" (जॉन ऑस्टिन ने कानून को संप्रभु का आदेश कहा). Exam Boosters: (1) Sir Henry Maine criticized Austin's theory using the example of Maharaja Ranjit Singh of Punjab (who never altered customary laws); (2) A. V. Dicey distinguished between 'Legal Sovereignty' (Parliament) and 'Political Sovereignty' (Electorate).
qe: Who propounded the Monistic (Legal) Theory of Sovereignty in 'Lectures on Jurisprudence' (1832), defining law as the "command of the sovereign"?

q: अपने 1958 के निबंध 'टू कॉन्सेप्ट्स ऑफ लिबर्टी' में 'नकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता' और 'सकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता' के बीच प्रसिद्ध भेद किसने किया?
e: Isaiah Berlin ('Two Concepts of Liberty', 1958) distinguished Negative Liberty ('freedom from') and Positive Liberty ('freedom to'), favouring Negative Liberty (आइज़िया बर्लिन ने नकारात्मक व सकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता में भेद किया). Exam Boosters: (1) T. H. Green championed Positive Liberty ("a positive power or capacity of doing or enjoying something worth doing"); (2) J. R. Seeley called Liberty "the opposite of over-government".
qe: Who famously distinguished between 'Negative Liberty' (freedom from interference) and 'Positive Liberty' (freedom to achieve self-mastery) in his 1958 essay 'Two Concepts of Liberty'?

q: 'ए थ्योरी ऑफ जस्टिस' (1971) के लेखक कौन हैं, जिन्होंने 'मूल स्थिति', 'अज्ञानता का आवरण' (Veil of Ignorance) और 'अंतर सिद्धांत' (Difference Principle) की अवधारणाएँ दीं?
e: John Rawls ('A Theory of Justice', 1971) defined "Justice as Fairness" through two principles: Equal Basic Liberties and the Difference Principle (inequalities are justified only if they benefit the least advantaged) (जॉन रॉल्स ने अज्ञानता के आवरण का सिद्धांत दिया). Exam Boosters: (1) Robert Nozick ('Anarchy, State, and Utopia', 1974) countered Rawls with his 'Entitlement Theory of Justice'; (2) Amartya Sen wrote 'The Idea of Justice' (2009) distinguishing 'Niti' and 'Nyaya'.
qe: Who authored 'A Theory of Justice' (1971), introducing the concepts of 'Original Position', 'Veil of Ignorance', and the 'Difference Principle'?

q: "अधिकार सामाजिक जीवन की वे परिस्थितियाँ हैं जिनके बिना कोई भी मनुष्य सामान्यतः अपना सर्वोत्तम विकास नहीं कर सकता।" — अधिकारों की यह प्रसिद्ध परिभाषा किसने दी?
e: Harold J. Laski gave this celebrated definition in 'A Grammar of Politics' (1925) (हेरोल्ड लास्की ने 'ए ग्रामर ऑफ पॉलिटिक्स' में यह परिभाषा दी). Exam Boosters: (1) Laski also wrote: "Every state is known by the rights that it maintains"; (2) T. H. Green defined Rights as "powers necessary to the fulfilment of man's vocation as a moral being".
qe: "Rights are those conditions of social life without which no man can seek, in general, to be himself at his best." — This classic definition of Rights was given by:

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'संप्रभुता के बहुलवादी सिद्धांत' (लास्की, कोल, ड्यूग्वी व क्रैबे द्वारा समर्थित) का मूल तर्क है?
o: The State is an absolute, omnipotent institution above all associations.
Society is federal in nature, so authority should be shared among the State and other autonomous social, economic, and cultural associations.
Sovereignty belongs solely to a hereditary monarch.
International law has no validity over domestic states.
e: Pluralists reject Austin's monistic absolute sovereignty and argue that because society is federal, sovereignty too must be federal/shared among diverse associations (बहुलवादियों के अनुसार समाज संघात्मक है, अतः सत्ता का भी विकेंद्रीकरण होना चाहिए). Exam Boosters: (1) Laski famously remarked: "It would be of lasting benefit to political science if the whole concept of sovereignty were surrendered."
qe: Which of the following is a core thesis of the 'Pluralist Theory of Sovereignty' (championed by Laski, Cole, Duguit, and Krabbe)?
oe: The State is an absolute, omnipotent institution above all associations.
Society is federal in nature, so authority should be shared among the State and other autonomous social, economic, and cultural associations.
Sovereignty belongs solely to a hereditary monarch.
International law has no validity over domestic states.

q: लोकतंत्र को "ऐसा शासन जिसमें प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का हिस्सा हो" किसने कहा, तथा "जनता का, जनता के द्वारा, जनता के लिए शासन" किसने कहा?
o: Lord Bryce and J. S. Mill
e: J. R. Seeley defined democracy as "a government in which everyone has a share", and Abraham Lincoln gave the Gettysburg Address (1863) definition "Government of the people, by the people, for the people" (सीले और अब्राहम लिंकन). Exam Boosters: (1) A. V. Dicey: "Democracy is a form of government in which the governing body is a comparatively large fraction of the entire nation"; (2) Joseph Schumpeter ('Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy') gave the Elitist/Procedural theory of democracy.
qe: Who defined Democracy as "a government in which everyone has a share", and who defined it as "Government of the people, by the people, for the people"?
oe: Lord Bryce and J. S. Mill

q: किस पुनर्जागरणकालीन राजनीतिक विचारक ने 'द प्रिंस' (1513) लिखी और राजनीति को धर्म व नैतिकता से पृथक करने के कारण "प्रथम आधुनिक राजनीतिक विचारक" कहलाता है?
e: Niccolò Machiavelli ('The Prince', 'The Discourses on Livy') separated politics from theology/morality and advised rulers to combine the qualities of a 'Lion' (strength) and a 'Fox' (cunning) (मैकियावेली को प्रथम आधुनिक राजनीतिक विचारक कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) W. A. Dunning called Machiavelli "the child of his times"; (2) Montesquieu ('The Spirit of the Laws', 1748) propounded the 'Theory of Separation of Powers'.
qe: Which Renaissance political thinker authored 'The Prince' (1513) and is called the "First Modern Political Thinker" for separating politics from religion and ethics?

q: प्लेटो का प्रसिद्ध 'गुफा का रूपक' (Allegory of the Cave), जो इंद्रियजनित भ्रम से 'शुभ के प्रत्यय' के सच्चे दार्शनिक ज्ञान की यात्रा को दर्शाता है, किस संवाद में मिलता है?
e: The Allegory of the Cave appears in Book VII of Plato's 'The Republic' (प्लेटो की 'रिपब्लिक' के सातवें खंड में गुफा का रूपक है). Exam Boosters: (1) In 'The Laws' (his last work), Plato abandoned the Philosopher King and accepted the 'Rule of Law' (Second-Best State).
qe: Plato's famous 'Allegory of the Cave' (गुफा का रूपक), illustrating the journey from sensory illusion to true philosophical knowledge of the 'Form of the Good', appears in which dialogue?

q: 'पॉलिटिक्स' के प्रथम खंड में दास प्रथा पर अरस्तू के विचारों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: Aristotle condemned all slavery as completely unnatural and immoral.
Aristotle proposed granting full citizenship rights to all slaves.
Aristotle justified 'natural slavery' arguing some humans lack full deliberative reason and benefit from being guided by a rational master, while opposing slavery by war/convention for Greeks.
Aristotle borrowed his defence of slavery from Karl Marx.
e: Aristotle defended 'natural slavery' as mutually beneficial (providing leisure to masters for civic life and moral guidance to slaves), while rejecting enslavement of Greeks by conquest (अरस्तू ने प्राकृतिक दासता का समर्थन किया).
qe: Which of the following statements about Aristotle's views on Slavery (in Book I of 'Politics') is correct?
oe: Aristotle condemned all slavery as completely unnatural and immoral.
Aristotle proposed granting full citizenship rights to all slaves.
Aristotle justified 'natural slavery' arguing some humans lack full deliberative reason and benefit from being guided by a rational master, while opposing slavery by war/convention for Greeks.
Aristotle borrowed his defence of slavery from Karl Marx.

q: किसने यह प्रसिद्ध टिप्पणी की कि "हॉब्स का लेवियाथन अंग्रेजी भाषा में लिखी गई राजनीतिक दर्शन की सबसे महान, संभवतः एकमात्र, श्रेष्ठ कृति है"?
e: British political philosopher Michael Oakeshott made this celebrated assessment of Hobbes's 'Leviathan' (माइकल ओकशॉट का कथन). Exam Boosters: (1) C. B. Macpherson ('The Political Theory of Possessive Individualism') interpreted Hobbes and Locke as theorists of early capitalist market society.
qe: Who remarked that "Hobbes's Leviathan is the greatest, perhaps the sole, masterpiece of political philosophy written in the English language"?

q: कार्ल मार्क्स के दर्शन में 'आधार और अधिरचना' (Base and Superstructure) की अवधारणा क्या दर्शाती है?
o: The economic mode of production (Base) fundamentally shapes the legal, political, religious, and ideological institutions (Superstructure) of society.
The military base determines the geographical borders of a state.
Education alone determines the nature of the State.
e: In Marx's Historical Materialism, the Economic Base (forces + relations of production) determines the Superstructure (State, law, religion, art, ideology) (आर्थिक आधार समाज की कानूनी, राजनीतिक व वैचारिक अधिरचना को निर्धारित करता है).
qe: In Karl Marx's philosophy, what does the concept of 'Base and Superstructure' (आधार और अधिरचना) signify?
oe: The economic mode of production (Base) fundamentally shapes the legal, political, religious, and ideological institutions (Superstructure) of society.
The military base determines the geographical borders of a state.
Education alone determines the nature of the State.

q: कौन-सी राजनीतिक विचारधारा राज्य को एक "आवश्यक बुराई" मानती है और न्यूनतम राज्य हस्तक्षेप ('अहस्तक्षेप / रात्रि-प्रहरी राज्य') की वकालत करती है?
e: Classical Liberalism / Individualism (Adam Smith, Herbert Spencer, Thomas Paine) views the State as a 'necessary evil' limited to defence, law-and-order, and enforcing contracts (शास्त्रीय उदारवाद/व्यक्तिवाद राज्य को आवश्यक बुराई मानता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Anarchism (Bakunin, Kropotkin, Proudhon) views the State as an 'Unnecessary Evil'; (2) Idealism (Hegel, Green) views the State as a positive moral organism; (3) Modern/Positive Liberalism (T. H. Green, Laski, Keynes) supports the Welfare State.
qe: Which political ideology views the State as a "Necessary Evil" and advocates minimal state intervention ('Laissez-faire' / Night-watchman State)?

q: बेनिटो मुसोलिनी का सर्वाधिकारवादी सूत्र "सब कुछ राज्य के भीतर, राज्य के बाहर कुछ नहीं, राज्य के विरुद्ध कुछ नहीं" किस विचारधारा से संबंधित है?
e: Italian Fascism (Benito Mussolini, Giovanni Gentile) glorified the totalitarian corporate state, ultra-nationalism, and war, rejecting both liberal democracy and Marxism (फासीवाद — मुसोलिनी). Exam Boosters: (1) Fabian Socialism (Britain, 1884 — Sidney & Beatrice Webb, G. B. Shaw) advocates gradual, peaceful parliamentary transition to socialism; (2) Syndicalism (France — Georges Sorel) advocates trade union control via General Strike.
qe: Which ideology is associated with Benito Mussolini's totalitarian maxim: "Everything within the State, nothing outside the State, nothing against the State"?

q: 'योग्यतम की उत्तरजीविता' (सामाजिक डार्विनवाद) वाक्यांश किसने गढ़ा और चरम व्यक्तिवाद का समर्थन करते हुए 'द मैन वर्सेस द स्टेट' (1884) लिखी?
e: British sociologist-philosopher Herbert Spencer coined "survival of the fittest" and argued against state welfare/poor laws in 'The Man Versus the State' (1884) (हर्बर्ट स्पेंसर ने 'द मैन वर्सेस द स्टेट' लिखी).
qe: Who coined the term 'Survival of the Fittest' (Social Darwinism) and wrote 'The Man Versus the State' (1884) advocating extreme Individualism?

q:
निम्नलिखित समाजवादी/वैचारिक धाराओं को उनके प्रमुख प्रवर्तकों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. काल्पनिक समाजवाद — (a) रॉबर्ट ओवेन एवं चार्ल्स फूरिये
2. श्रेणी समाजवाद — (b) जी. डी. एच. कोल
3. फेबियन समाजवाद — (c) सिडनी एवं बीट्रिस वेब
4. वैज्ञानिक समाजवाद — (d) कार्ल मार्क्स एवं फ्रेडरिक एंगेल्स
e: Utopian Socialism — Saint-Simon, Robert Owen, Charles Fourier; Guild Socialism — G. D. H. Cole; Fabian Socialism — Sidney & Beatrice Webb, G. B. Shaw; Scientific Socialism — Marx & Engels. Correct match: 1-a, 2-b, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following Socialist / Ideological traditions with their chief exponents:
1. Utopian Socialism — (a) Robert Owen & Charles Fourier
2. Guild Socialism — (b) G. D. H. Cole
3. Fabian Socialism — (c) Sidney & Beatrice Webb
4. Scientific Socialism — (d) Karl Marx & Friedrich Engels

q: 'नव-उदारवाद' / स्वेच्छातंत्रवाद के प्रमुख प्रवर्तक कौन हैं जिन्होंने 'द रोड टू सर्फडम' (1944) लिखकर चेतावनी दी कि राज्य का आर्थिक नियोजन अनिवार्यतः सर्वाधिकारवाद की ओर ले जाता है?
e: Austrian-British economist Friedrich Hayek ('The Road to Serfdom', 1944; 'The Constitution of Liberty', 1960) was a leading critic of central planning and welfare state intervention (फ्रेडरिक हायेक ने 'द रोड टू सर्फडम' लिखी). Exam Boosters: (1) Milton Friedman ('Capitalism and Freedom') and Robert Nozick are other major neoliberal/libertarian thinkers.
qe: Who is the chief proponent of 'Neoliberalism' / Libertarianism who wrote 'The Road to Serfdom' (1944), warning that state economic planning inevitably leads to totalitarianism?

q: किस ब्रिटिश अधिनियम ने भारतीय प्रांतों में पहली बार 'द्वैध शासन' (आरक्षित और हस्तांतरित विषय) की शुरुआत की?
e: The Government of India Act, 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms) introduced Dyarchy in the provinces and bicameralism at the Centre (1919 के अधिनियम ने प्रांतों में द्वैध शासन लागू किया). Exam Boosters: (1) Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) introduced communal separate electorates for Muslims (Lord Minto called 'Father of Communal Electorate'); (2) Government of India Act, 1935 abolished provincial dyarchy, introduced Provincial Autonomy, and provided for an All-India Federation and Federal Court.
qe: Which British Act introduced 'Dyarchy' (dual governance — Reserved and Transferred subjects) in the Indian Provinces for the first time?

q: किस अधिनियम के तहत कलकत्ता में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय (1774) की स्थापना हुई और बंगाल के गवर्नर को 'बंगाल का गवर्नर-जनरल' नामित किया गया?
e: The Regulating Act of 1773 made Warren Hastings the first Governor-General of Bengal and set up the Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta (1774, First Chief Justice: Sir Elijah Impey) (1773 के रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट के तहत). Exam Boosters: (1) Charter Act 1833 made the Governor-General of Bengal the 'Governor-General of India' (Lord William Bentinck); (2) Government of India Act 1858 ended Company rule and created the Viceroy (Lord Canning).
qe: Which Act established the Supreme Court at Calcutta (1774) and designated the Governor of Bengal as the 'Governor-General of Bengal'?

q: स्वतंत्रता-पूर्व किस ऐतिहासिक अधिनियम ने भारतीय संविधान के लगभग दो-तिहाई भाग (संघीय, प्रांतीय व समवर्ती सूचियों सहित) का संरचनात्मक आधार प्रदान किया?
e: The Government of India Act, 1935 provided the federal scheme, office of Governor, Judiciary, Public Service Commissions, emergency provisions, and three legislative lists (भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935 भारतीय संविधान का सबसे बड़ा स्रोत है).
qe: Which landmark pre-independence Act provided the structural blueprint for nearly two-thirds of the Indian Constitution, including the three-fold legislative lists (Federal, Provincial, Concurrent)?

q: किस योजना के अंतर्गत नवंबर 1946 में कुल 389 सदस्यों के साथ भारत की संविधान सभा का गठन किया गया था?
e: The Constituent Assembly (389 seats: 296 British India + 93 Princely States; 1 seat per ~10 lakh population) was constituted under the Cabinet Mission Plan (1946) (कैबिनेट मिशन योजना, 1946 के अंतर्गत संविधान सभा का गठन हुआ).
qe: Under which Plan was the Constituent Assembly of India constituted in November 1946 with a total strength of 389 members?

q: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय या उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा जारी किस रिट का शाब्दिक अर्थ "शरीर को प्रस्तुत करना" होता है, जो व्यक्तियों को अवैध निरोध से बचाती है?
e: Habeas Corpus (बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण) orders the detaining authority to produce the detained person before the court to test the legality of detention (बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण अवैध गिरफ्तारी के विरुद्ध जारी होती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Mandamus ('We command') directs a public official to perform a statutory duty; (2) Quo Warranto ('By what authority') challenges illegal usurpation of a public office; (3) Prohibition & Certiorari are issued to lower courts/tribunals.
qe: Which writ issued by the Supreme Court or a High Court literally means "to have the body of", protecting individuals against illegal detention?

q: भारतीय संविधान की कौन-सी प्रमुख विशेषता मुख्य रूप से आयरलैंड के संविधान से ली गई है?
e: Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV), Presidential election method, and nomination of 12 Rajya Sabha members were borrowed from Ireland (नीति निदेशक तत्व आयरलैंड से लिए गए हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Fundamental Rights & Judicial Review — USA; (2) Parliamentary System & Rule of Law — UK; (3) Concurrent List & Joint Sitting — Australia; (4) Federalism with strong Centre — Canada.
qe: Which Constitutional feature of India was borrowed primarily from the Constitution of Ireland (Irish Constitution)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 368 के अंतर्गत संघीय प्रावधानों (जैसे राष्ट्रपति निर्वाचन या GST परिषद) को प्रभावित करने वाले संविधान संशोधन विधेयक के लिए आवश्यक है:
o: Special majority of Parliament plus ratification by at least half of the State Legislatures
Approval via a nationwide public referendum
e: Federal amendments under Article 368(2) require Special Majority in both Houses (majority of total membership + 2/3rd present & voting) PLUS ratification by at least half of State Legislatures by simple majority (संसद के विशेष बहुमत के साथ कम से कम आधे राज्यों की स्वीकृति). Exam Boosters: (1) Constitutional Amendment procedure was borrowed from South Africa; (2) No Joint Sitting is allowed for an Article 368 bill; (3) 24th Amendment (1971) made Presidential assent to Constitutional Amendment Bills mandatory.
qe: Under Article 368 of the Indian Constitution, a Constitutional Amendment Bill affecting federal provisions (such as Presidential election or GST Council) requires:
oe: Special majority of Parliament plus ratification by at least half of the State Legislatures
Approval via a nationwide public referendum

q: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के किस ऐतिहासिक निर्णय (1973) ने 'मूल संरचना का सिद्धांत' (Basic Structure Doctrine) प्रतिपादित किया कि संसद अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संविधान के मूल ढाँचे को नहीं बदल सकती?
e: In Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (24 April 1973, 13-judge bench, 7:6 verdict), the SC established the Basic Structure Doctrine (केशवानंद भारती वाद, 1973 में मूल संरचना का सिद्धांत दिया गया). Exam Boosters: (1) Minerva Mills Case (1980) affirmed harmony and balance between Fundamental Rights and DPSP as part of Basic Structure; (2) S. R. Bommai Case (1994) affirmed Secularism and Federalism as Basic Structure.
qe: Which landmark Supreme Court judgment (1973) propounded the 'Basic Structure Doctrine', ruling that Parliament cannot alter the basic features of the Constitution under Article 368?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अंतर्गत निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से मौलिक अधिकार केवल भारत के नागरिकों को प्राप्त हैं, विदेशियों को नहीं?
e: Five Fundamental Rights — Articles 15, 16, 19, 29, and 30 — are available EXCLUSIVELY to Indian citizens, whereas Articles 14, 20, 21, 21A, 22, 23, 24, 25–28 apply to both citizens and foreigners (except enemy aliens) (अनुच्छेद 15, 16, 19, 29 और 30 केवल भारतीय नागरिकों के लिए हैं).
qe: Which of the following Fundamental Rights under the Indian Constitution are available ONLY to Citizens of India and NOT to foreigners?

q: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 60 के अंतर्गत भारत के राष्ट्रपति को पद की शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
e: The Chief Justice of India (and in their absence, the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court) administers the oath to the President (भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश राष्ट्रपति को शपथ दिलाते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) President submits resignation to the Vice-President; (2) Impeachment of the President is under Article 61 (sole ground: 'Violation of the Constitution'); (3) Minimum age for President/Vice-President/Governor = 35 years.
qe: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India under Article 60 of the Constitution?

q: भारतीय संसदीय प्रणाली में अनुच्छेद 75(3) के अंतर्गत केंद्रीय मंत्रिपरिषद सामूहिक रूप से किसके प्रति उत्तरदायी होती है?
e: Under Article 75(3), the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha (House of the People) (केंद्रीय मंत्रिपरिषद सामूहिक रूप से लोकसभा के प्रति उत्तरदायी होती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Individually, ministers hold office during the pleasure of the President [Art. 75(2)]; (2) 91st Amendment Act (2003) capped the size of Council of Ministers at 15% of Lok Sabha strength (including PM).
qe: In the Indian parliamentary system, the Union Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to which body under Article 75(3)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 312 के अंतर्गत कौन-सी विशेष शक्ति केवल राज्यसभा को प्राप्त है?
o: Passing a No-Confidence Motion against the Government
Ratifying the Union Budget Demands for Grants
Authorizing Parliament to create a new All-India Service by a two-thirds majority
e: Under Article 312, Rajya Sabha alone can pass a resolution (by 2/3rd of members present and voting) authorizing Parliament to create new All-India Services (अनुच्छेद 312 के तहत नई अखिल भारतीय सेवा का सृजन). Exam Boosters: (1) Under Article 249, Rajya Sabha alone can authorize Parliament to legislate on a State List subject in national interest; (2) Rajya Sabha is a permanent House (1/3rd members retire every 2 years; term = 6 years).
qe: Which special power belongs EXCLUSIVELY to the Rajya Sabha under Article 312 of the Indian Constitution?
oe: Passing a No-Confidence Motion against the Government
Ratifying the Union Budget Demands for Grants
Authorizing Parliament to create a new All-India Service by a two-thirds majority

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत भारत के राष्ट्रपति 'वित्तीय आपातकाल' की उद्घोषणा कर सकते हैं, जो भारत में अब तक कभी लागू नहीं हुआ?
e: Article 360 deals with Financial Emergency (never proclaimed in India) (अनुच्छेद 360 वित्तीय आपातकाल से संबंधित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Article 352 — National Emergency (declared 3 times: 1962, 1971, 1975); (2) Article 356 — President's Rule / State Emergency; (3) Once approved by Parliament, Financial Emergency continues indefinitely without periodic parliamentary renewals.
qe: Under which Article can the President of India proclaim a 'Financial Emergency', which has NEVER been declared in India so far?

q: 1983 में गठित किस आयोग ने 1988 में केंद्र–राज्य संबंधों पर व्यापक रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की और सिफारिश की कि अनुच्छेद 356 का प्रयोग केवल "अंतिम उपाय" के रूप में किया जाए?
e: The Sarkaria Commission (chaired by Justice R. S. Sarkaria, 1983–88) made 247 recommendations on Centre-State relations, including establishing a permanent Inter-State Council under Article 263 (सरकारिया आयोग, 1983 केंद्र-राज्य संबंधों पर गठित हुआ). Exam Boosters: (1) Punchhi Commission (2007–10) was the second Centre-State Relations Commission; (2) Inter-State Council was formally established in 1990.
qe: Which Commission (constituted in 1983) submitted a comprehensive report in 1988 on Centre–State Relations, recommending that Article 356 be used strictly as a "measure of last resort"?

q: किस समिति (1957) ने भारत में त्रि-स्तरीय पंचायती राज व्यवस्था (ग्राम पंचायत, पंचायत समिति, जिला परिषद) की स्थापना की सिफारिश की थी?
e: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended 'Democratic Decentralization' via a 3-tier Panchayati Raj system; Rajasthan (Nagaur district, 2 Oct 1959) became the first state to inaugurate it (बलवंत राय मेहता समिति ने त्रि-स्तरीय पंचायती राज की सिफारिश की). Exam Boosters: (1) Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) recommended a 2-tier system; (2) L. M. Singhvi Committee (1986) recommended constitutional status for Panchayats; (3) Lord Ripon (1882 Resolution) is called the 'Father of Local Self-Government in India'.
qe: Which committee (1957) recommended the establishment of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system (Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, Zila Parishad) in India?

q: 73वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 (अनुच्छेद 243D) के अंतर्गत पंचायती राज संस्थाओं में महिलाओं के लिए न्यूनतम कितने प्रतिशत सीटें आरक्षित हैं?
e: Article 243D mandates not less than one-third (33%) reservation for women in all Panchayats (including chairperson posts); many states (Bihar, MP, Uttarakhand, etc.) have voluntarily raised it to 50% (संविधान में न्यूनतम एक-तिहाई / 33% आरक्षण अनिवार्य है). Exam Boosters: (1) Minimum age to contest Panchayat elections is 21 years; (2) State Election Commission (Article 243K) conducts Panchayat elections; (3) State Finance Commission (Article 243I) reviews Panchayat finances every 5 years.
qe: Under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 (Article 243D), what is the minimum percentage of seats reserved for women in Panchayati Raj Institutions?

q: पेसा अधिनियम (PESA Act, 1996) किस समिति की सिफारिश पर संविधान के भाग IX के प्रावधानों को संशोधनों सहित पाँचवीं अनुसूची के क्षेत्रों में विस्तारित करता है?
e: Enacted on 24 December 1996 based on the Dilip Singh Bhuria Committee report (1995), PESA empowers Gram Sabhas in Fifth Schedule tribal areas (10 states) over minor forest produce and local resources (भूरिया समिति की सिफारिश पर PESA अधिनियम 1996 लागू हुआ).
qe: The PESA Act (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas Act), 1996 extends the provisions of Part IX of the Constitution with modifications to Fifth Schedule areas on the recommendation of which committee?

q: अनुच्छेद 148 के अंतर्गत भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG), जिसे "सार्वजनिक धन का संरक्षक" कहा जाता है, की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: The CAG is appointed by the President of India by warrant under hand and seal for a term of 6 years or up to age 65 (whichever is earlier) (CAG की नियुक्ति भारत के राष्ट्रपति करते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) CAG is removed in the same manner as a Supreme Court Judge; (2) CAG acts as the 'friend, philosopher, and guide' of Parliament's Public Accounts Committee (PAC, 22 members: 15 LS + 7 RS).
qe: Who appoints the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India under Article 148, often called the "Guardian of the Public Purse"?

q: अनुच्छेद 280 के अंतर्गत कौन-सा संवैधानिक निकाय प्रत्येक पाँच वर्ष में संघ और राज्यों के बीच करों के शुद्ध आगमों के वितरण की सिफारिश करता है?
e: The Finance Commission (constituted every 5 years by the President under Article 280, comprising a Chairman + 4 members) recommends vertical and horizontal tax devolution (अनुच्छेद 280 — वित्त आयोग). Exam Boosters: (1) 1st Finance Commission Chairman: K. C. Neogy (1951); (2) 15th Finance Commission Chairman: N. K. Singh; (3) 16th Finance Commission Chairman: Dr. Arvind Panagariya.
qe: Which Constitutional Body under Article 280 recommends the distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Union and the States every five years?

q: लोकतंत्र में 'राजनीतिक दल' और 'दबाव समूह' (हित समूह) के बीच प्रमुख अंतर निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है?
o: Pressure groups contest elections directly to form the government, whereas political parties do not.
Pressure groups are unconstitutional in India.
Political parties contest elections to capture political power, whereas pressure groups seek to influence public policy from outside without contesting elections.
Political parties represent only a single occupational group.
e: Political parties directly field candidates in elections to form government, while pressure groups (trade unions, FICCI, farmers' unions) lobby and influence policy without contesting elections (दबाव समूह चुनाव लड़े बिना नीतियों को प्रभावित करते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Gabriel Almond classified pressure groups into Institutional, Associational, Non-associational, and Anomic; (2) Rajni Kothari termed India's early post-independence party system the 'Congress System'.
qe: Which of the following is a key difference between a 'Political Party' and a 'Pressure Group' (Interest Group) in a democracy?
oe: Pressure groups contest elections directly to form the government, whereas political parties do not.
Pressure groups are unconstitutional in India.
Political parties contest elections to capture political power, whereas pressure groups seek to influence public policy from outside without contesting elections.
Political parties represent only a single occupational group.

q: जनप्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम और निर्वाचन आयोग के मानदंडों के अनुसार, भारत में किसी राजनीतिक दल को 'राष्ट्रीय दल' के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त करने के लिए कौन-सी शर्त पर्याप्त है?
o: Winning 1 seat in Lok Sabha from any one state
Having registered offices in two Union Territories
Securing 2% votes in a single State Assembly election
Being recognized as a 'State Party' in at least four states
e: A party gets National Party status if it meets ANY ONE of 3 criteria: (1) Recognized as a State Party in at least 4 states; OR (2) Wins at least 2% of Lok Sabha seats (11 seats) from at least 3 different states; OR (3) Polls at least 6% valid votes in 4 or more states in LS/Assembly elections AND wins 4 LS seats (कम से कम 4 राज्यों में राज्य स्तरीय दल की मान्यता पर्याप्त है).
qe: Under the Representation of the People Act and Election Commission criteria, which condition is sufficient for a political party to be recognized as a 'National Party' in India?
oe: Winning 1 seat in Lok Sabha from any one state
Having registered offices in two Union Territories
Securing 2% votes in a single State Assembly election
Being recognized as a 'State Party' in at least four states

q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय (ICJ) — जो संयुक्त राष्ट्र का एकमात्र प्रमुख अंग है जिसका मुख्यालय न्यूयॉर्क से बाहर है — का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: The International Court of Justice (15 judges elected for 9-year terms) is headquartered at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय का मुख्यालय द हेग, नीदरलैंड में है). Exam Boosters: (1) The other 5 principal UN organs (UNGA, UNSC, ECOSOC, Trusteeship Council, Secretariat) are headquartered in New York; (2) UN was founded on 24 October 1945 (UN Day); (3) Five permanent UNSC members (P5 with veto): USA, UK, France, Russia, China.
qe: Where is the headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) — the ONLY principal organ of the United Nations located outside New York?

q: दक्षेस (SAARC — दक्षिण एशियाई क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संगठन, स्थापना 1985) का स्थायी सचिवालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: SAARC was founded on 8 December 1985 in Dhaka, and its permanent Secretariat is located in Kathmandu, Nepal (सार्क का सचिवालय काठमांडू, नेपाल में है). Exam Boosters: (1) SAARC has 8 members: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, and Afghanistan (joined 2007); (2) ASEAN (1967, 10 members) Secretariat is in Jakarta (Indonesia); (3) BIMSTEC Secretariat is in Dhaka (Bangladesh).
qe: Where is the permanent Secretariat of SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, founded in 1985) located?

q: राजनीति–प्रशासन द्वैतवाद (Politics–Administration Dichotomy) की वकालत करने वाले 1887 के ऐतिहासिक निबंध 'द स्टडी ऑफ एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन' के लिए किसे 'लोक प्रशासन का जनक' माना जाता है?
e: Woodrow Wilson (28th US President) authored 'The Study of Administration' (1887), establishing Public Administration as an independent academic discipline (वुडरो विल्सन लोक प्रशासन के जनक हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Max Weber formulated the Ideal-Type Bureaucracy (Legal-Rational Authority); (2) Luther Gulick coined the famous management acronym 'POSDCORB'; (3) F. W. Taylor is the 'Father of Scientific Management'.
qe: Who is universally recognized as the 'Father of Public Administration' for his seminal 1887 essay 'The Study of Administration', advocating the Politics–Administration Dichotomy?
